**1 — Scene:** A plate of stir-fried noodles with meat and vegetables in a glossy brown sauce, accompanied by a glass of milk and a wrapped cheese portion.

**2 — Vessel:** The shallow plate appears approximately **23 cm** across. Its area is \(3.14 × 11.5² ≈ 415\text{ cm²}\).

**3 — Items:** Noodles, meat strips, small vegetable pieces (apparently onion/mushroom), brown sauce, and cooking oil. Separately: milk and an apparent cheese portion.

**4–6 — Area, volume and weight:**

| Item | Plate area covered | Area × height = gross volume | Density → weight |
|---|---:|---|---|
| Noodles | 55% | 228 cm² × 1.6 cm = 365 ml | 0.8 → **292 g** |
| Meat strips | 12% | 50 cm² × 0.8 cm = 40 ml | 1.0 → **40 g** |
| Vegetables | 8% | 33 cm² × 1.0 cm = 33 ml | 0.6 → **20 g** |

The projected shares total **75% of the plate**, consistent with the visible coverage. Sauce and oil coat these ingredients rather than occupying separate plate areas: approximately **15 g sauce** and **7 g oil**.

The milk occupies roughly **250 ml** (approximately 6 cm internal diameter × 8.8 cm liquid depth), giving **258 g** at 1.03 g/ml. The wrapped cheese appears to be a small wedge, roughly **25 ml**, or **25 g**; its exact type and size are uncertain.

**7 — Energy:**

| Item | Weight | kcal/100 g | Estimated kcal |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Cooked noodles, excluding added oil | 292 g | 145 | 423 |
| Cooked meat | 40 g | 220 | 88 |
| Vegetables | 20 g | 35 | 7 |
| Brown sauce | 15 g | 50 | 8 |
| Cooking oil | 7 g | 884 | 62 |
| Milk | 258 g | 50 | 129 |
| Cheese portion | 25 g | 340 | 85 |

**8 — Sanity check:** Approximately **374 g and 588 kcal on the plate**, or **657 g and 802 kcal including milk and cheese**, is plausible for what is visible. Oil quantity, milk fat level, and the wrapped cheese are the largest uncertainties.
